Explore the learn-p5 Expo app codebase at /workspaces/learn-p5. I need to understand several features.

Find and read:
1. The fullscreen feature for the sketch/preview — search for "fullscreen", "Fullscreen", "FullScreen". Understand current implementation and why it doesn't cover the full viewport as expected.
2. The exercise view's "reference popup" shown when long-pressing the Run button — search for "long press", "longPress", "Run", "reference popup", "referenceModal". Read the relevant files.
3. The Reference route — search for "reference", "Reference", where example code is rendered as plain text. Find where example code is displayed (look for "example", "plain text", render of code).
4. How p5.js is bundled during build — search for "p5.js", "p5", "bundleP5", build scripts in package.json or scripts/. Understand the build process and how the p5 version is determined.
5. The "Debugging" settings option and associated code — search for "Debugging", "debug", "Debug". Find routes, components, and any logic.

Return: file paths with line numbers, key code snippets, and clear summaries for each of the 5 areas. Be thorough — read full files where relevant.
I'll explore the codebase systematically, starting with parallel searches across all 5areas.
